Path: business objects, records and views | records-forms.form-view-gallery | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx` (it reads the `recordReadOutstanding` gate 0 times, where `DrawerForm.tsx` reads it twice) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the modal edit arm can take typing while its first record read is in flight. The landing record then discards what was typed, and the save sends the whole record with the original values. CI measured that payload once through the real `ModalForm` (`editDirtyPayload-10156`, run `36147629257`). It is the objectui#10190 defect on the `DrawerForm` twin, which was graded p2 ⇒ p2, as its twin. It also reds a required check on unrelated PRs.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T15:36Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: measure first, the way objectui#10190 measured the drawer. Type into the first rendered input while `findOne` is held open, then release it and submit. If the typed value is lost, give `ModalForm` the gate PR objectui#10256 landed, ⛔ not a test-only retry or a timeout raise. The existing `describe.each` row is then the pin.

Clause-②: no

Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T15:45Z. PR objectui#10670 (this seat, objectui#10612, in contract review) edits `ModalForm.tsx` and `DrawerForm.tsx` in the field-gate call, a different hunk from the first-read gate. The dev runs `git merge-tree` against it and main before pushing. `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

`Clause-②: no` — the modal edit arm begins holding its loading state until the first record read lands, as the drawer twin already does; no export, schema or accept set moves.
